content.short: Brazilian wallet and financial app with merchant payments.
content.description: PicPay is one of Brazil's largest digital wallets and financial super apps, serving tens of millions of users with payments, banking, and social money features. Through the app, people can hold a digital account, pay with a card, send money to friends, use Pix, pay bills, shop, and access credit, savings, and even crypto trading, while merchants accept payments and run promotions. PicPay blends everyday financial services with a social, cashback-driven experience that made peer-to-peer payments popular in Brazil. By combining wallet, account, cards, credit, and merchant tools at scale, PicPay competes with banks and other Brazilian fintechs to be a primary financial app for consumers and small businesses across the country.
